# Agriculture (Wales) Act 2023

The Agriculture (Wales) Act 2023 () is an act of Senedd Cymru relating to agriculture in Wales.
Provisions
The act includes measures to address climate change, restore biodiversity and promote the sustainable production of food.
The act requires farmers to "maintain and enhance" the environment in order to be eligible for subsidies. The scheme which administers this is the Sustainable Farming Scheme (SFS). The act includes a requirement for 10% of land to be tree cover in order for a site to be eligible for subsidies.
The legislation bans the use of snares.
Under amendments made during the legislative passage which had been sought by the monarch, properties owned by the monarch are exempt from the legislation.
Reception
The ban on the use of snares was praised by the League Against Cruel Sports.
The Pembrokeshire Herald criticised the Sustainable Farming Scheme as potentially decrease agricultural productivity, and therefore possibly reduce availability and variety of food produced in Wales.
